metadata.summary: Manchester United's famous ticker banner returned to Old Trafford on Saturday, displaying 50 years since Manchester City won a trophy.
metadata.content: Man City charges: Manchester United fans take aim at rivals with return of famous ticker banner | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man City charges: Manchester United fans take aim at rivals with return of famous ticker banner Man Utd fans' famous banner mocking the years since Man City won a trophy returned to Old Trafford on Saturday; United were playing first game since City were found guilty of all serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission Saturday 10 October 2026 19:08, UK Image: The banner displays 50 years - ticking over to 51 years - since Man City won the 1976 League Cup Manchester United's famous ticker banner returned to Old Trafford on Saturday, displaying 50 years since Manchester City won a trophy. The banner was first displayed in 2000, at which point it was 24 years since City last won a trophy - the 1976 League Cup. The year listed on the banner ticked over every year until 2011, when City ended their trophy drought by beating Stoke in the FA Cup final - their first silverware since Sheikh Mansour's takeover. metadata.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended by Portugal after walking out on the national team.
metadata.content: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portuguese Football Federation provisionally suspends forward after walkout following disagreement with manager Jorge Jesus | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cristiano Ronaldo: Portuguese Football Federation provisionally suspends forward after walkout following disagreement with manager Jorge Jesus Cristiano Ronaldo walked out on the Portugal national team after accusing Jorge Jesus of reneging on an agreement to bring him as a substitute in a win over Norway; 41-year-old went on to release near 2,000-word statement in which he accused the manager of a "breach of trust" Saturday 10 October 2026 17:58, UK Image: Ronaldo played for Portugal last month before leaving the camp Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended by Portugal after walking out on the national team. Ronaldo left the Portugal squad after he was an unused substitute for a 2-1 win away to Norway in the Nations League on September 27. The 41-year-old, who has scored a record-breaking 146 goals in 234 appearances for his country, subsequently issued a near 2,000-word statement saying he withdrew from the squad after a "breach of trust" between him and head coach Jorge Jesus.
